description: Personal Claude Code harness, packaged as an installable plugin.

plugins.name: mh
plugins.description: A Matt-Pocock-first Claude Code harness. Five computational deny/ask gates (irrecoverable commands, subagent git guard, task-complete separation, test integrity, config-write guard), SessionStart injection of a 4 KB METHODOLOGY, and memory-lint for the auto-memory store. Composes mattpocock-skills instead of duplicating it.
